def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrian_patches = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")
    sidewalk_patches = image_patch.find("sidewalk")

    if not pedestrian_patches or not road_patches or not sidewalk_patches:
        return []

    pedestrian_patches = [p for p in pedestrian_patches if p.vertical_center < min(r.vertical_center for r in road_patches) and p.vertical_center < min(s.vertical_center for s in sidewalk_patches)]

    return pedestrian_patches
